description: This Java source file defines a custom Android View called InternalSelectionView, which displays multiple selectable rows and manages internal selection, including focus and drawing behaviors.

classes.name: InternalSelectionView
classes.description: A custom View that manages a fixed number of selectable rows, handles internal navigation, focus changes, and renders the selection visually.

methods.name: InternalSelectionView
methods.description: Constructs an InternalSelectionView with specified context, number of rows, and optional label.

methods.name: getNumRows
methods.description: Returns the total number of rows.

methods.name: getSelectedRow
methods.description: Returns the index of the currently selected row.

methods.name: setDesiredHeight
methods.description: Sets a desired height for the view.

methods.name: getLabel
methods.description: Returns the label associated with this view.

methods.name: onMeasure
methods.description: Measures the view's dimensions based on the provided measure specs.

methods.name: measureWidth
methods.description: Calculates the desired width based on measure spec.

methods.name: measureHeight
methods.description: Calculates the desired height based on measure spec and internal state.

methods.name: onDraw
methods.description: Handles rendering of rows, background, selection highlight, and row labels.

methods.name: getRectForRow
methods.description: Populates a Rect with the bounds of a specified row.

methods.name: ensureRectVisible
methods.description: Ensures the selected row's rectangle is visible on the screen.

methods.name: onKeyDown
methods.description: Handles key events for navigation (up/down) between rows.

methods.name: getFocusedRect
methods.description: Defines the rectangle of the currently focused row.

methods.name: onFocusChanged
methods.description: Responds to focus changes to update selected row.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns label string if available, override of object method for debugging.
